  • Method Details

    • group

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder group(String id, SlotGroupCategory category, Storage storage)
      Adds a slot group (priority 100, columns from its size). Structure only: per-slot rules (gate, binding, mending, shift-click) are declared by address in the engine, ideally in CustomMenu.Builder.arm.

    • group

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder group(String id, SlotGroupCategory category, Storage storage, int priority)
      Adds a slot group with a shift-click priority (higher is tried first).

    • group

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder group(String id, SlotGroupCategory category, Storage storage, int priority, int columns)
      Adds a slot group with a priority and a column count.

    • group

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder group(String id, SlotGroupCategory category, Storage storage, int priority, int columns, int rowGapAfter, int rowGapSize)
      Adds a slot group with a priority, a column count and a gap of rowGapSize after row rowGapAfter.

    • rightClick

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder rightClick(BiConsumer<net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, CreatedSlot> handler)
      A right-click handler for the last-added group; a right click on one of its slots runs it instead of vanilla's click. It runs on both sides, like any click: the client's run is its prediction and the server's is the one that counts. Put an effect that belongs to one side behind player.level().isClientSide().

    • pairsWith

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder pairsWith(String targetPanelId, String targetGroupId)
      Pairs the last-added group with a target group, tried first when shift-clicking out of it ("panelId.groupId" resolved at build). Call once per target.

    • hidden

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder hidden()
      The panel starts hidden; the server shows it (CustomContainerMenu.setPanelVisible(String, boolean)).

    • toggleable

      public SlotLayout.PanelBuilder toggleable()
      A player may show and hide this panel (its toggle key or CustomContainerScreen.togglePanel). Without it the server refuses the request.
